summary: Iter23 bugfix verification for (1) Teacher/student classes list root alias, (2) Google OAuth redirect_to using current origin, (3) FeeStructure→checkAuth() tier refresh, (4) JEEM2027→NEX2027 batch migration + 21 preseed roster. Backend pytest 8/9 passed (1 skipped, no admin students endpoint). DB directly verified: 0 profiles in JEEM2027, 17 in NEX2027, 21 preseed rows, Shefali present w/ default_password='shefali2027'. Frontend E2E: teacher can schedule new class and it renders on /teacher/classes (empty state gone); Google Sign-In captured URL is 'https://nexu-qbank.preview.emergentagent.com%2Fauth%2Fcallback' (current origin, URL-encoded); /upgrade shows current-tier='Free' for student@test.com. However student /classes page (My Classes) does NOT show the newly scheduled class — root cause: ClassesPage.js calls GET /api/classes (returns 404) instead of the working /api/student/classes/ (or /my-classes) endpoint. Additionally, DB returns 'scheduled_date_time' while ClassesPage.js reads 'scheduled_datetime'. This blocks the student half of Bug #1 even though the backend piece is fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: Calls api.get('/classes') which returns 404. Should call '/student/classes/' or '/student/classes/my-classes'. As a result NEX2027 students see 0 upcoming classes on My Classes page even though the backend correctly returns the class.
Reads classData.scheduled_datetime but backend returns scheduled_date_time. Even if endpoint is corrected, CountdownTimer + date/time formatting will silently fail (NaN/Invalid Date).

integration_issues.issue: 404 from /api/classes hides the newly scheduled NEX2027 class from students; renders 'Check back soon for upcoming live classes!' empty state.

action_items: Fix src/pages/ClassesPage.js line 395: change api.get('/classes') → api.get('/student/classes/my-classes') (or '/student/classes/'). Response shape is { success, classes: [...] } so map response.data.classes.
Also map scheduled_date_time → scheduled_datetime (or update ClassesPage to read scheduled_date_time) so upcoming/past filtering and CountdownTimer work.
Optional: add response_model / json_safe rename in student_class_routes.py to normalize the field name in the API layer to avoid future drift.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend/backend contract drift: server returns 'scheduled_date_time' (Postgres column) whereas the older ClassesPage.js was written for 'scheduled_datetime'. Consider standardizing at the API layer (json_safe) rather than at multiple call sites.

Google OAuth /auth/google/url is a GET endpoint that returns the authorize URL as JSON — the frontend then sets window.location.href to it. Because Supabase Site URL in the dashboard may still point to localhost:3000, the explicit redirect_to query param is what protects preview/prod. Verified end-to-end.
cleanup_batches() runs on every startup and is idempotent (WHERE batch_id='JEEM2027'), which is fine. Consider logging moved count at WARNING level once (not repeatedly) so re-runs are noise-free.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3 of 4 flows fully green — student /classes list flow broken by pre-existing endpoint bug)

seed_data_creation: None. Backend E2E test creates+deletes its own TEST class. Frontend E2E left one class 'E2E_iter23_<ts>' owned by teacher@test.com — safe to leave or clean via DELETE /api/teacher/classes/{class_id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent updates ClassesPage.js endpoint + field mapping, re-run playwright student flow to confirm '[data-testid="next-class-card"]' or '[data-testid="upcoming-class-card"]' renders. Backend pytest already covers /student/classes/ root alias returning NEX2027 class — no backend re-test needed. Backend passed for Google OAuth and preseed. Do not attempt Razorpay payment; verifying tier through /auth/me is enough.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 has two halves. Backend half (teacher list route missing / mismatch) is fixed by the new @router.get('') alias on both teacher_class_routes and student_class_routes plus /stats alias — verified via pytest and browser (teacher sees 6 cards after scheduling; empty state gone). Student half is still visibly broken because src/pages/ClassesPage.js was never updated to call the correct endpoint — it still calls '/api/classes' which does not exist in server.py's router registrations (routes are all under prefixed routers like /teacher/classes, /student/classes, etc.). Fix: either (a) switch the frontend call to '/student/classes/my-classes' AND read scheduled_date_time, or (b) add a legacy '/classes' alias on api_router in server.py that proxies to student_class_routes.my_classes with a compatibility field rename. Bug #2, #3, #4 are all verified working.
